construction_notes.text: City status Under Review as of the 2026-10-28 update. The city describes an eight-story residential project; rental or for-sale is not stated.

City Active Planning record PLN-2026-88 (application PLN-APP20571), project name "1475 S. BASCOM (HDP-II) (Pacific Development)", work type Housing Development Project, status Under Review, last updated 2026-11-06. The description cites the State Density Bonus Law and the City's Small Scale Housing Density Bonus Program, and includes removal of existing city street trees along the Bascom Avenue frontage. Case manager: Stephen Rose.
